metrics.name: reach
metrics.title: Accounts reached
metrics.description: The number of unique accounts that have seen this post, at least once. Reach is different from impressions, which may include multiple views of your post by the same accounts. This metric is estimated.

metrics.name: views
metrics.title: Views
metrics.description: The number of times your post was played or displayed.

metrics.name: likes
metrics.title: Likes
metrics.description: The number of likes on your post.

metrics.name: comments
metrics.title: Comments
metrics.description: The number of comments on your post.

metrics.name: saved
metrics.title: Saved
metrics.description: The number of saves of your post.

metrics.name: shares
metrics.title: Shares
metrics.description: The number of shares of your post.

metrics.name: total_interactions
metrics.title: Post interactions
metrics.description: The number of likes, saves, comments and shares on your post minus the number of unlikes, unsaves and deleted comments.

metrics.name: profile_visits
metrics.title: Profile Visits
metrics.description: The number of times your profile was visited.

metrics.name: follows
metrics.title: Follows
metrics.description: This is how many accounts started following you.
